safety_lead_time.comparison_action: DECREASE: Recommended safety lead time lower than SAP

narrative: Inventory optimization for PL1__M9B56DBE: Demand regime is smooth with 0.37 CV. Lead time is moderate (CV=0.26). The dominant driver of safety stock is lead_time_variability (72.2%). Recommended policy: maintain 13468 units safety stock, reorder at 40703 units with order quantity 31251. This provides 95% service level. Compared to SAP baseline (0 safety stock), the optimized policy increases annual costs by $3397.62 but significantly improves service reliability.
